Ms. Marjorie is paddleboarding out to celebrate her anniversary with Hurricane Harrigan on Seal Island when she disappears!; Mayor Humdinger can't find his kitties, so he runs to the Safety and Rescue Pups for help!

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E10 — Big Truck Pups Save a Sliding Chalet; Big Truck Pups Save a Really Big Dish
The pups try to save Jake's chalet from crashing; the mayor downs a satellite dish.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E18 — Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups and the Big Twin Trick; Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Save the Mega Mayor
The Ladybird is up to her old tricks again, but this time the Mighty Twins have a super trick of their own; Mayor Humdinger finally gets superpowers, and it's a total cat-astrophe.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E24 — Pups Save Captain Crinkle-Cut/Pups Save the Big Nightlight
A french fry mascot needs help after being carried away by a flock of hungry seagulls; Mayor Humdinger tries to steal the Adventure Bay lighthouse.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Peppa's Circus; Night Animals; Pirate Treasure; Garden Games; Going Boating
Peppa and her friends put on a circus; Peppa and George stay up late to hunt for slugs and snails; Pirate Peppa buries a treasure chest; Daddy Pig gives Peppa an old box of garden games; everyone goes boating at the lake.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
The Eye Test; Grandad Dog's Garage; Foggy Day; Jumble Sale; Swimming
Peppa's friend wears glasses; Peppa's car runs out of petrol; Peppa and George play at the playground; Peppa's play group holds a jumble sale; Peppa's family goes to the pool.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Paper Games; Grandpa's Robot; Granny Sheep Moves In; Cardboard Boxes
Madame Gazelle teaches the children paper games; Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house; Peppa plays at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in; Peppa is at Suzy's house and takes the cardboard outside.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Parachute Jump; Miss Rabbit's Taxi; Playing Pretend; Scooters; George's Racing Car
The school roof is leaking, so Mummy Pig does a parachute jump to raise money to fix it; Miss Rabbit spends the day picking people up and dropping people off in her job as taxi driver.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Nursery Rhymes; Digger World; The Doll Hospital; Wendy Wolf's Birthday; Princess Peppa
Madame Gazelle and the playgroup share their best nursery rhymes; Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to Digger World, where they build walls and knock them over again.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Move to Music; School Project; Simple Science; Pedro Is Late; Gerald Giraffe
Madame Gazelle gets Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music; for their school project, Peppa and her friends build castles and bring them into playgroup.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Mr. Bull Is Getting Married; Getting Ready for a Wedding; The Wedding Day; Party Bus; Families
Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow are getting married; everyone gets ready for the wedding; the day of Mrs. Cow and Mr. Bull's wedding arrives; Peppa gets an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party; the children draw family pictures.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Around the World; Castle; Grandpa Pig's Train to the Rescue
Miss Rabbit lends Peppa and her family a plane for the day, and they get swept off on an adventure around the world; the family visits a castle; when Miss Rabbit's train breaks down, Grandpa Pig lends her his little train, Gertrude.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Roller Disco; Weather Station; Talking; Grandpa's Rock Garden; Winter Games
Madame Gazelle has organized a roller disco; the children learn about the weather; there is a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama; Grandpa Pig is making a rock garden; Peppa and family go skiing.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Sibling School; Patchwork Quilt; New Baby; Baby Names; Holding the Baby
Peppa and George learn how to be the best siblings; Peppa is making a quilt for the baby; on the day of the baby's arrival, Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
Moto Pups: Pups vs. the Ruff-Ruff Pack; Moto Pups: Pups Save the Donuts; Moto Pups: Pups Save the Kitties; Moto Pups: Pups Save a Moto Mayor
The heroic rescue pups, led by a tech-savvy boy named Ryder work together to protect the community; geared with special skills, gadgets and vehicles that help them on their rescue missions, the PAW Patrol is always up for the challenge.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
Pups vs the Hum-flectors; Pups Save a Capybara; Jungle Pups: Pups Save the Meerkat Pirates; Pups Save a Turbot Tournament
The heroic rescue pups, led by a tech-savvy boy named Ryder work together to protect the community; geared with special skills, gadgets and vehicles that help them on their rescue missions, the PAW Patrol is always up for the challenge.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S14 E07 — A Zuma Pirate Adventure
Having made a big blunder in a recent rescue, Zuma trades in his usual chill attitude and becomes a super serious pup; his new persona gets tested when an actual pirate arrives, bent on hidden treasure and willing to destroy things to get it!

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E13 — Pups Save a Show Jumper; Pups Save the Salmon
Winnie Winnington goes looking for a frog to enter in a frog-jumping contest and ends up needing to be rescued in a swamp; the pups try to help salmon get to an ocean and also need to rescue Alex.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E06 — Dino Rescue: Pups and the Lost Dino Eggs
When a lost world of dinosaurs is discovered, Mayor Humdinger wants to take dino eggs back to Foggy Bottom, but along the way a baby Brachiosaurus ends up in dino-sized trouble.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E04 — Pups Save the Honey; Pups Save Mayor Goodway's Purse
Yumi's Yummy Honey is all the buzz when it -- and her beehive -- go missing from her farm; Mayor Goodway's purse disappears, along with its precious cargo, Chickaletta.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E19 — Hum-Patrol to the Rescue!; Pups Save Morning Mountain Yoga
When Adventure Bay holds a raffle, a pair of nest-building seagulls snatch the winning prize; a rockslide leaves Mayor Goodway, Farmer Yumi and Garby stranded on the side of a mountain.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
Best of Ultimate Rescue
A collection of the PAW Patrol's Ultimate Rescue missions.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E12 — Pups Save the Snowshoeing Goodways; Pups Save a Duck Pond
When Mayor Goodway and the twins are late getting back from snowshoeing, Jake and Everest call the PAW Patrol to search for them; when water in the duck pond mysteriously drains out, it is up to the PAW Patrol to find out what's happening.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E03 — Pups Save an Antarctic Martian; Pups Save the Maze Explorers
Travelling Travis is on another great adventure when he lands in Antarctica but believes he's actually on Mars; Mr. Porter and Alex go on a sightseeing hike but get trapped inside a huge maze.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E18 — Fire Rescue: Pups Save the Big BBQ
Adventure Bay gets a fire station; when disaster strikes during the opening day BBQ, it's up to the PAW Patrol in their new fire rescue gear and vehicles to put it out.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E22 — Pups Save a Humsquatch; Pups Save a Far Flung Flying Disc
When Travelling Travis yelps for help when he finds a mysterious creature in trouble, the PAW Patrol heads to Foggy Bottom to save a Humsquatch; when a robo-toy causes mayhem in Adventure Bay, Ryder knows just who to call.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E20 — Moto Pups: Pups vs. the Ruff-Ruff Pack
Stunt motorcyclist Wild Cat joins the patrol to try to keep Ruff-Ruff Pack troublemakers from trashing the town.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E05 — Pups Save Their Digi-Tal Friends; Pups Save the Rainbow
The PAW Patrol must save the day when two overly helpful robots take on more than they can handle; in a dream, Mayor Humdinger finds a prism that makes rainbows and drains Adventure Bay of color; the pups must restore color to Adventure Bay.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E01 — Pups Save the Wacky Water Skiers; Pups Save the Mayor's Assistant
When Emmy and Eddie take a joyride, Hurricane Harrigan and Cap'n Turbot get caught water-skiing behind the out-of-control boat.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E18 — Pups Save Little Hairy; Pups Save a Kooky Climber
Big Hairy's little brother falls into a hole, and Tracker gets carried away by Big Hairy; Danny tries extreme rock climbing with Ace Sorenson.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E16 — All Paws on Deck
Ryder and his team of pups must take on 10-year-old genius Codi Gizmodi, who has her sights set on building her own high-tech city to replace Adventure Bay; joining the team are Everest, Tracker, Sweetie, Tuck and Ella, Rex, Liberty and more.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E25 — Pups Save the Woof and Roll Show; Pups Save an Eagle
When a storm blows through the town right before a concert, the pups must work together to clean up the mess; Mayor Goodway's backpack slips down the side of a cliff with Chickaletta in it.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E26 — Taste Buddies!
When Chefs Molly and Gil bring their tasty food truck to Bland Land, they discover that Baron von Bland only lets his subjects eat Bland Bread; the Chefs must find a way to bring taste to the kingdom.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E04 — Build Me a Building!
The Bubble Guppies learn about construction while building a doghouse for Bubble Puppy.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E17 — Don't Yuck My Yum!
In the Gourmet Galaxy, everyone loves yummy food, but when Gen. Yuck turns everything icky, only a recipe for delicious moon muffins can stop her; master chef Goby and his apprentice, Deema, must bake those muffins and save the galaxy.

title: Team Umizoomi
description:
S04 E14 — Umi Knights
Milli, Geo and Bot are UmiKnights who must save the kingdom by helping a dragon find his glasses.

title: Team Umizoomi
description:
S01 E14 — The Butterfly Dance Show
The team must help Sophia complete her butterfly costume before the Butterfly Dance Show.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E13 — Mighty Pups vs. The Mayor of the Universe
Liberty and the Poms team up with the Mighty Pups to save Adventure Bay from being crushed by a giant, flying Top Hat.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E06 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Water Walker; Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Windsurfer
Mayor Humdinger swipes Francois' water-walking shoes and ends up trapped in a pit-like turtle nest; the pups spring into action when a nearby volcano erupts.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E25 — Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save a Runaway Stargazer
A comet is coming, and the PAW Patrol gets to work building a giant observatory; when the observatory starts rolling out of control, Rubble and the pups need to rebuild everything it has destroyed.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S05 E07 — The Crew Builds an Underwater Shell Museum; The Crew Builds a Giant Shoe Store
Wheeler discovers a giant ancient shell deep in a cave, but when the pups try to dig it out, the cave almost collapses; the pups have to save Wheeler when ducks take him for a wild ride on Shopkeeper Shelley's giant shoe-shaped shoe store!

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S01 E12 — The Crew Does a Home Renovation; The Crew Builds a Lighthouse
Mix and Rubble are starstruck when their favorite TV renovation star, Hank Hammer, comes to see them at work; Cap'n Turbot is bringing Mayor Goodway to visit her sister, Mayor Greatway; when a fog rolls in, the pups must build a lighthouse quickly.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E19 — Pups Save Queen Cluck-Cluck; Pups Save a Desert Flounder
Mayor Goodway dreams she's traveled to the mysterious Cluck Cluck Island, a very strange land where Chickaletta is royalty; Traveling Travis' balloon gets caught on the Flounder.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S12 E10 — Pups Save a Big Brother; Pups Save a Giant Baby
Farmer Yumi dreams about what her new baby will be like when she's bigger.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E22 — Pups Save a Floundering Francois; Pups Save the Pop-Up Penguins
Cap'n Turbot and his cousin Francois are watching white whales in Adventure Bay when their boat hits a rock and starts to sink; the PAW Patrol must track down some loose penguins and help them return to the land of ice and snow.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E12 — Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Meet the Mighty Twins
When bandit Ladybird shrieks havoc in Adventure Bay and takes all the town's treasures, the Mighty Pups team up with new super pals, the Mighty Twins, to save the day -- and Mayor Goodway.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E15 — Pups Save a Baby Caribou; Pups Save Luke and His Luke-Alike
When a baby caribou winds up speeding down a mountainside, it's up to the PAW Patrol to save the calf and reunite it with its family; when Luke Stars gets blown away in a giant tumbleweed, Digi and Tal make a duplicate which dances out of control.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E13 — Pups Save the Big Book Delivery; Pups Save the Puppets
Mayor Humdinger's kitties make off with Mayor Goodway's book delivery truck; Julius and Julia get into a sticky situation when the paper bag puppets they created for a puppet show become stuck on the antlers of a deer.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E05 — Winter Sports Chompetition!
Gil and Bubble Puppy are competing in the Winter Sports Chompetition, a competition for athletes and their dogs; they hope to stop reigning champs Coldsnap and his dog Mr. Husky from cheating to win the gold.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E17 — Happy Clam Day!
The Bubble Guppies have to learn about the mail so they can send invitations to a party for Clam.
